CFML Language Reference: Functions

DecrementValue

Drops the fractional part of a number and subtracts one.

Category

Mathematical functions

Syntax

DecrementValue(number)

Parameters

number
Any number.

Returns

An integer.

Usage

DecrementValue(17.5) is 16, not 16.5. If you want to keep the fraction, just write n - 1. IncrementValue goes the other way.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>number</TH><TH>DecrementValue(number)</TH><TH>number - 1</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="n" LIST="10,17.5,1,0.25">
<CFOUTPUT><TR><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#DecrementValue(n)#</TD><TD ALIGN="RIGHT">#n - 1#</TD></TR></CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
<P>Countdown:
<CFSET n = 5>
<CFLOOP CONDITION="n GT 0"><CFOUTPUT>#n#... </CFOUTPUT><CFSET n = DecrementValue(n)></CFLOOP>
Happy New Year!
